BackstoryDef.title: machine mother's whelp
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] claims to have been born long ago in an unknown cultivation facility. [PAWN_pronoun] also insists that [PAWN_pronoun] was assigned to the 32nd division at birth and dropped like a space marine. None of it makes much sense.

BackstoryDef.title: orphan of the damp cave
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] claims to have been born in a crack between rocks deep inside a cramped, damp cave. While exploring, [PAWN_pronoun] found a chamber filled with yellow metal drums marked with the incomprehensible words 'radioactive waste'.

BackstoryDef.title: child of the rabbit shrine maiden
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] claims to be the child of a rabbit shrine maiden. [PAWN_possessive] mother fought goblins with mysterious powers, but their numbers overwhelmed her. Reduced to breeding stock, she was punished under the command to 'birth as many as you killed' until she died giving birth to [PAWN_nameDef]. A faint trace of her strange power seems to remain in [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: child of the fleshbeasts
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] says that fleshbeasts destroyed [PAWN_possessive] tribe. Yet there is no record that a goblin settlement ever existed where [PAWN_pronoun] claims it did. Is [PAWN_nameDef] simply lying, as goblins often do?

BackstoryDef.title: discarded test subject
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] claims that humans in white coats captured [PAWN_objective] and performed unknown experiments. What kind of experiments could they have been?

BackstoryDef.title: megaspider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] insists that [PAWN_pronoun] was born from a megaspider's ovipositor and is, in fact, a megaspider. It is an absurdly stupid claim, even for a goblin.

BackstoryDef.title: wandering goblin shaman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] claims to have wandered between goblin villages performing 'miracles'. Is [PAWN_nameDef] truly the miracle-working shaman from those stories, or merely a braggart?

BackstoryDef.title: taciturn goblin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is unnaturally quiet. Unlike any proper goblin, [PAWN_pronoun] is calm and composed - disturbingly so.

BackstoryDef.title: wriggling loincloth
BackstoryDef.description: Something under [PAWN_nameDef]'s loincloth always seems to be wriggling. What could it possibly mean? Whatever it is, other goblins give [PAWN_objective] strange looks and keep their distance.

BackstoryDef.title: eerie goblin wanderer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] looks terribly old, as though [PAWN_pronoun] has lived for fifty years. [PAWN_pronoun] is also exceptionally quiet.

BackstoryDef.title: one who speaks with flesh
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] claims that [PAWN_pronoun] can speak with fleshbeasts.
